headline: Walmart (WMT) Launches 40,000 Acre Regenerative Agriculture Effort With General Mills And ADM
summary: Walmart (NasdaqGS:WMT), General Mills and ADM are working together on a new regenerative agriculture program. The initiative covers 40,000 Midwest wheat acres with goals tied to soil health, water quality and carbon sequestration. The collaboration is designed as a model for broader industry change across food and retail supply chains. This move puts Walmart's role in the food supply chain in focus, as the company links its retail scale to farm level practices. For investors, it adds...

headline: Back to School Spending Expected to Set Records as Shoppers Hunt for Bargains
summary: Kids are heading back to the classroom, and the retailer trade group expects spending on supplies to hit a record $146.8 billion, more than Mother’s and Father's Day, Easter, and the Super Bowl combined.
